batch_node.name: Samsite users seed v0.2.0
batch_node.description: Seeds the people in the samsite story as identity_core `human` nodes: Readers (the site's audience), george (the operator reproducing and modeling the system in TAP), and Sam (Sam Aydlette, author of the original samaydlette.com system). A human is found again by its `handle` (identity_core's natural key), so each carries one. The `human` type carries no per-model tags field, so the landing search reaches these via an explicit MATCH (u:identity_core__human) rather than the Project=samsite tag scan. Edges/roles and projection placement are intentionally not seeded here. v0.2.0: moved from computing_core `user` to identity_core `human` (samsite-tap#33): computing_core retired `user`, whose meaning duplicated `human` (computing-core-tap#27, highbar Q160). The nodes have fresh entity ids because a row cannot change type; on a grid seeded from v0.1.0 the three old `user` rows stay until computing_core's 0.5 migration deletes them, and the landing no longer matches them. `human` has no description field, so the per-person notes live here: Readers are the visitors who consume samaydlette.com and its published compliance artifacts; george reproduces and models the samsite system in TAP; Sam Aydlette wrote the original samaydlette.com system and its FedRAMP 20x compliance machinery.
